cat >> /workspace/devtests/test_audit.py <<'EOF'

# ================================================================ part 2
FAILS.clear()

A_KEYS = keys('A')

def runA(payloads, **kw):
    """payloads: list of (payload, pn) application packets"""
    events = [A_KEYS]
    for p, pn in payloads:
        events.append(dg(short_header(b'\xaa', pn, p), [0]))
    t = trace(events, **kw)
    return run([t])['traces'][0]

# canonical packet number width grows with the number
r = runA([(b'\x01', 256)])
canon = short_header(b'\xaa', 256, b'\x01', pnlen=2)
check('width.2', r['packets'][0]['sha256']==sha(canon), (r['packets'][0]['sha256'], sha(canon)))

# stream direction errors
r = runA([(b'\x08\x03\x00', 0)])   # stream id 3 -> server uni
check('stream.dir3', r['packets'][0]['status']=='STREAM_STATE_ERROR', r['packets'][0])
r = runA([(b'\x08\x04\x00', 0)])   # stream id 4 -> client uni index 1
check('stream.uni4', r['packets'][0]['status']=='OK', r['packets'][0])
r = runA([(b'\x05\x02\x00', 0)])   # stop sending on client uni -> state error
check('stop.uni', r['packets'][0]['status']=='STREAM_STATE_ERROR', r['packets'][0])
r = runA([(b'\x08\x01\x00', 0)])   # server bidi index 0 (local.bidi=2) -> allowed
check('stream.serverbidi', r['packets'][0]['status']=='OK', r['packets'][0])

# stream limit
t = trace([A_KEYS, dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, b'\x08\x08\x00'), [0])], limits={'connection':2**62-1,'stream':2**62-1,'bidi':1,'uni':2**60,'cids':4})
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('stream.limit', r['packets'][0]['status']=='STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR', r['packets'][0])

# implicit opening counts
t = trace([A_KEYS, dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, b'\x08\x08\x00'), [0])], limits={'connection':2**62-1,'stream':2**62-1,'bidi':4,'uni':2**60,'cids':4})
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('stream.opened', r['opened']=={'bidi':3,'uni':0}, r['opened'])
check('stream.rows', [s['id'] for s in r['streams']]==[8], r['streams'])

# flow control
t = trace([A_KEYS, dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, b'\x08\x00\x04abcd'), [0])], limits={'connection':2**62-1,'stream':3,'bidi':2**60,'uni':2**60,'cids':4})
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('stream.flow', r['packets'][0]['status']=='FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR', r['packets'][0])

# final size errors: fin beyond the final size
t = trace([A_KEYS,
           dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, b'\x0b\x00\x01a'), [0]),
           dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 1, b'\x0f\x00\x01\x00b'), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('stream.final', r['packets'][1]['status']=='FINAL_SIZE_ERROR', r['packets'][1])
check('stream.final.closed', r['closed']=={'event':2,'packet':0,'offset':0,'code':'FINAL_SIZE_ERROR'}, r['closed'])

# overlapping bytes with different content -> protocol violation
t = trace([A_KEYS,
           dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, b'\x09\x00\x01a'), [0]),
           dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 1, b'\x0d\x00\x00\x01b'), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('stream.overlap', r['packets'][1]['status']=='PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', r['packets'][1])

# equal overlap is fine
t = trace([A_KEYS,
           dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, b'\x09\x00\x01a'), [0]),
           dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 1, b'\x0d\x00\x00\x01a'), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('stream.sameoverlap', r['packets'][1]['status']=='OK', r['packets'][1])
check('stream.sameoverlap.unique', r['streams'][0]['unique']==1 and r['streams'][0]['high']==1, r['streams'])

# reset stream then stream frame discards bytes
t = trace([A_KEYS,
           dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, b'\x04\x00\x01\x02'), [0]),
           dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 1, b'\x09\x00\x01z'), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('reset.status', r['packets'][0]['status']=='OK', r['packets'][0])
check('reset.state', r['streams'][0]['reset']==1 and r['streams'][0]['final']==2 and r['streams'][0]['high']==2, r['streams'][0])
check('reset.after', r['packets'][1]['status']=='OK', r['packets'][1])
check('reset.after.bytes', r['streams'][0]['unique']==0 and r['streams'][0]['high']==2, r['streams'][0])

# reset with a final size below the high water mark
t = trace([A_KEYS,
           dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, b'\x09\x00\x02ab'), [0]),
           dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 1, b'\x04\x00\x01\x01'), [0])])
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('reset.below', r['packets'][1]['status']=='FINAL_SIZE_ERROR', r['packets'][1])

# max data / max stream data / max streams
r = runA([(b'\x10\x40\x20' + b'\x11\x00\x40\x10' + b'\x12\x02' + b'\x13\x03', 0)])
check('max.status', r['packets'][0]['status']=='OK', r['packets'][0])
check('max.data', r['send_max_data']==0x2020, r['send_max_data'])
check('max.streams', r['send_max_streams']=={'bidi':2,'uni':3}, r['send_max_streams'])
check('max.streamdata', r['streams'][0]['send_max']==0x1010, r['streams'])

# max streams above 2^60
r = runA([(b'\x12' + varint(2**60+1), 0)])
check('max.limit', r['packets'][0]['status']=='FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', r['packets'][0])

# new connection id with retire prior to
ncid = b'\x18' + varint(2) + varint(2) + bytes([1]) + b'\xdd' + bytes(16)
r = runA([(ncid, 0)])
check('ncid.retire', r['retire_prior_to']==2 and [c['sequence'] for c in r['peer_cids']]==[2], (r['retire_prior_to'], r['peer_cids']))

# connection id limit
ncid1 = b'\x18' + varint(1) + varint(0) + bytes([1]) + b'\xdd' + bytes(16)
ncid2 = b'\x18' + varint(2) + varint(0) + bytes([1]) + b'\xee' + bytes(16)
ncid3 = b'\x18' + varint(3) + varint(0) + bytes([1]) + b'\xef' + bytes(16)
t = trace([A_KEYS, dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 0, ncid1), [0]), dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 1, ncid2), [0]), dg(short_header(b'\xaa', 2, ncid3), [0])],
          limits={'connection':2**62-1,'stream':2**62-1,'bidi':2**60,'uni':2**60,'cids':2})
r = run([t])['traces'][0]
check('ncid.limit', r['packets'][2]['status']=='CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR', r['packets'][2])
check('ncid.limit.rollback', [c['sequence'] for c in r['peer_cids']]==[0,1,2], r['peer_cids'])

# datagram and path frames are ignored
r = runA([(b'\x31\x02xy' + b'\x1a' + bytes(8), 0)])
check('misc.status', r['packets'][0]['status']=='OK', r['packets'][0])
canon = short_header(b'\xaa', 0, b'\x31\x02xy' + b'\x1a' + bytes(8), pnlen=1)
check('misc.canonical', r['packets'][0]['sha256']==sha(canon), (r['packets'][0]['sha256'], sha(canon)))

# ack ecn
ack = b'\x03' + varint(4) + varint(0) + varint(0) + varint(0) + varint(1) + varint(2) + varint(3)
r = runA([(ack, 0)])
check('ackecn.ecn', r['acknowledged'][2]['ecn']==[1,2,3], r['acknowledged'][2])
check('ackecn.count', r['acknowledged'][2]['count']==5, r['acknowledged'][2])

print()
print('failures:', FAILS)
sys.exit(1 if FAILS else 0)
EOF
